findings.title: Security group allows ALL traffic from the internet
findings.detail: All protocols/ports open to 0.0.0.0/0
findings.remediation: Remove the rule; allow only the specific ports and source ranges required.

findings.title: EBS snapshot is publicly shared
findings.detail: Any AWS account can create a volume from this snapshot and read its data.
findings.remediation: Remove the 'all' createVolumePermission and enable 'Block public access for EBS snapshots'.

findings.title: Root account does not have MFA enabled
findings.detail: The root user can do anything in the account, including closing it.
findings.remediation: Enable MFA (hardware key or virtual) on the root user and lock the credentials away.

findings.title: Bucket policy allows public access
findings.detail: Statement(s) grant Principal '*' with no Condition. Actions: s3:GetObject
findings.remediation: Remove the Principal '*' statement or scope it with a Condition (e.g. aws:SourceVpce, aws:PrincipalOrgID).

findings.title: SSH (port 22) open to the internet
findings.detail: Rule tcp 22-22 from 0.0.0.0/0
findings.remediation: Restrict the source to known IPs, or use SSM Session Manager / a VPN instead of exposing management and database ports.

findings.title: RDP (port 3389) open to the internet
findings.detail: Rule tcp 3389-3389 from ::/0
findings.remediation: Restrict the source to known IPs, or use SSM Session Manager / a VPN instead of exposing management and database ports.

findings.title: Console user without MFA
findings.detail: 'jsmith' can sign in to the console with only a password.
findings.remediation: Require MFA for this user (or move human users to IAM Identity Center).

findings.title: AdministratorAccess attached directly to a user
findings.detail: 'jsmith' has full admin rights via a direct policy attachment.
findings.remediation: Grant permissions through groups/roles, apply least privilege, and use role assumption for admin tasks.

findings.title: Inline policy grants full admin (*:*)
findings.detail: Inline policy 'deploy-everything' on 'ci-deploy' allows Action '*' on Resource '*'.
findings.remediation: Replace with a scoped managed policy; inline policies are hard to audit.

findings.title: Customer-managed policy grants full admin (*:*)
findings.detail: 'LegacyPowerUser' is attached to 1 principal(s).
findings.remediation: Scope the policy to the actions and resources actually needed.

findings.title: Bucket ACL grants access to a public group
findings.detail: READ granted to everyone on the internet
findings.remediation: Set Object Ownership to 'Bucket owner enforced' to disable ACLs, or remove the public grant.

findings.title: Instance allows IMDSv1
findings.detail: IMDSv1 is vulnerable to SSRF-based credential theft (the Capital One breach vector).
findings.remediation: Set HttpTokens=required (enforce IMDSv2) on the instance and in launch templates.

findings.title: EBS encryption by default is disabled
findings.detail: New volumes in this region will not be encrypted unless requested explicitly.
findings.remediation: Enable 'Always encrypt new EBS volumes' in EC2 settings for every region you use.

findings.title: EBS volume is not encrypted
findings.detail: 50 GiB volume (unattached).
findings.remediation: Snapshot it, copy the snapshot with encryption, and restore to a new encrypted volume.

findings.title: EBS volume is not encrypted
findings.detail: 8 GiB volume (i-3e03d3b6a98a0b49a).
findings.remediation: Snapshot it, copy the snapshot with encryption, and restore to a new encrypted volume.

findings.title: EBS volume is not encrypted
findings.detail: 8 GiB volume (i-f131710b838db2da5).
findings.remediation: Snapshot it, copy the snapshot with encryption, and restore to a new encrypted volume.

findings.title: Account-level S3 Block Public Access is not fully enabled
findings.detail: Disabled settings: BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, RestrictPublicBuckets
findings.remediation: Enable all four Block Public Access settings at the account level (S3 console > Block Public Access settings for this account).

findings.title: Bucket Block Public Access is not fully enabled
findings.detail: Disabled settings: BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, RestrictPublicBuckets
findings.remediation: Turn on all four Block Public Access settings for this bucket unless it intentionally serves public content (prefer CloudFront + OAC for that).

findings.title: Bucket Block Public Access is not fully enabled
findings.detail: Disabled settings: BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, RestrictPublicBuckets
findings.remediation: Turn on all four Block Public Access settings for this bucket unless it intentionally serves public content (prefer CloudFront + OAC for that).

findings.title: No default encryption configured
findings.detail: Bucket has no server-side encryption configuration.
findings.remediation: Enable default encryption (SSE-S3 at minimum, SSE-KMS for sensitive data).

findings.title: No default encryption configured
findings.detail: Bucket has no server-side encryption configuration.
findings.remediation: Enable default encryption (SSE-S3 at minimum, SSE-KMS for sensitive data).

findings.title: Password policy is weaker than recommended
findings.detail: minimum length 8 (< 14); password reuse prevention < 24
findings.remediation: Raise minimum length to 14 and reuse prevention to 24.

findings.title: Versioning is not enabled
findings.detail: Deleted or overwritten objects (e.g. by ransomware) cannot be recovered.
findings.remediation: Enable versioning; pair it with lifecycle rules to control cost.

findings.title: Versioning is not enabled
findings.detail: Deleted or overwritten objects (e.g. by ransomware) cannot be recovered.
findings.remediation: Enable versioning; pair it with lifecycle rules to control cost.

findings.title: Server access logging is disabled
findings.detail: No request-level access logs for incident investigation.
findings.remediation: Enable server access logging (or CloudTrail S3 data events) to a separate log bucket.
